verdict.rationale: The only async path in the evidence is that the OCR model supports the batch endpoint (/v1/batch), which implies offloaded jobs, but no doc describes job status polling for it. Community testers describe the standard OCR API as synchronous, and one hit a timeout on a 900-page document and had to split it into chunks, so long parses can block or fail without a workaround. Missing for 10: documented async job submission for single long parses, explicit status-polling docs, completion webhooks/callbacks, and hands-on corroboration of non-blocking large-document processing.
